split.note: phases are sequential per PR: open → last commit (building/rework incl. inspection fixes and main merges, OR idle waiting between commits — e.g. for an owner decision; git cannot separate the two) → CI start (queue) → CI end (verify) → merge (wait: merge decision); shares of the summed open→merge time over merged PRs. The phases can overlap with an earlier CI run that the snapshot does not keep (latest run only) — report-only

honesty: NOT_MEASURED is preserved wherever the repository holds no record (provider € / tokens, € budget, inspection verdict time, pre-PR build time)
native €0 is reported only from the GO STRATEGY rationale; it does not cover the provider session
native-written lines are evidence data produced by a GO-dispatched run; native-built code merged is reported separately
inspection timing is an upper bound from commit subjects naming an inspection finding, never a recorded verdict time
